purpose: Freeze the retrospective scientific evaluation before candidate-control outcomes and sealed target outcomes are read, preventing feature fishing, threshold fitting, candidate replacement, or post-hoc metric selection.

analysis_population.target_units: each of the six frozen target drainage units exactly once after separate permitted target unblind
analysis_population.control_candidate_units: each of the seven frozen shortlisted candidate drainage units exactly once

control_disposition_use.NOT_CONTROL_AFFIRMATIVE_ACTIVATION: supplementary positive class because selection was outcome-blind
control_disposition_use.OUTCOME_UNKNOWN: excluded from outcome-discrimination calculations without replacement

analysis_population.duplicate_shortlist_membership: A candidate appearing in multiple target shortlists remains one unique analysis unit and is never duplicated or weighted by shortlist frequency.

common_preunblind_features.feature_policy: Report every frozen rainfall feature. Do not select a preferred duration/window because it separates outcomes better. Morphology is retained for susceptibility/context and matching diagnostics; no monotonic activation direction is asserted for morphology in this single-event evaluation.

primary_outcome_blind_hypothesis.direction: Higher frozen pre-anchor rainfall accumulation is hypothesized to be associated with activation, evaluated separately for each of the eight fixed windows.

always_report: raw frozen feature values by unique analysis unit
for each rainfall window: activated-class median, negative-class median, median difference activated minus negative
for each rainfall window: complete rank ordering with ties retained
conditional_if_at_least_two_activated_an: ROC AUC for each of the eight rainfall windows with higher rainfall fixed as the positive direction
postunblind_statistics.if_class_count_condition_not_met: Do not calculate inferential/discrimination statistics that require both classes; mark the metric INDETERMINATE_SMALL_N and retain descriptive values only.
postunblind_statistics.multiplicity_policy: All eight rainfall windows are co-primary descriptive tests; do not choose, hide, or relabel windows based on outcome separation.

paired_matching_use.rule: For each target, report the frozen three-candidate shortlist and available adjudicated dispositions without replacing unknown or activated candidates. Do not select the best surviving CONTROL after outcomes are known as though it were the preregistered match.

interpretation_limits.allowed_conclusion: The case may provide reproducible retrospective evidence for or against rainfall-feature separation under the frozen design, with explicit small-sample and evidence limitations. Any fitted multivariable model, threshold, operational score, or production promotion requires a new preregistered protocol and independent events.

forbidden_after_outcome_read: select a rainfall duration because it performs best and present it as preregistered primary
fit or tune an activation threshold
drop affirmative activated candidate-controls from the record
promote any result to production or operational alerting
